prompt: Which sentence says: Once you have decided, do not change it?
options: 一旦你决定了，就不要改变。
一旦你决定了，不要就改变。
zh: 一旦你决定了，就不要改变。
en: Once you have decided, do not change it.
Once it gets dark, we will go home.
wrong: 如果一旦天黑，我们就回家。
explain: 一旦 already means once or if; do not add 如果.

zh: 他很努力，从而取得了好成绩。
en: He worked hard and so achieved good results.

prompt: Which sentence says: Tomorrow we will either take the train or take a plane?
options: 明天我们或是坐火车，或是坐飞机。
明天我们或是坐火车，还是坐飞机。
zh: 明天我们或是坐火车，或是坐飞机。
en: Tomorrow we will either take the train or take a plane.
explain: 或是 pairs with 或是.

zh: 明天他或是来，或是打电话。
en: Tomorrow he will either come or call.
explain: 或是 + choice, 或是 + choice.

en: Whether one goes or not, it is all the same.

prompt: Which sentence says: Whether it is rice or noodles, I like them both?
options: 吃米饭也好，吃面条也好，我都喜欢。
吃米饭也好，吃面条好，我都喜欢。
zh: 吃米饭也好，吃面条也好，我都喜欢。
en: Whether it is rice or noodles, I like them both.
explain: Each part ends with 也好.

zh: 坐车也好，走路也好，我都行。
en: Whether by bus or on foot, I am fine with either.
Counting me, there are five people in all.

zh: 我们买了书、笔以及本子。
en: We bought books, pens and notebooks.
wrong: 我们买了书、笔以及和本子。
explain: 以及 already joins the last item.

en: Without effort, there is no success.

prompt: Which sentence says: Without friends, there is no happiness?
en: Without friends, there is no happiness.
explain: The second part is also 没有.

en: Without air, there is no life.
wrong: 没有空气，就不没有生命。

prompt: Which sentence says: He leaves early so as to catch the train?
options: 他早点出门，以便赶上火车。
他早点出门，便以赶上火车。
zh: 他早点出门，以便赶上火车。
en: He leaves early so as to catch the train.
We take the school as the centre.
He takes getting into university as his goal.
wrong: 他以考上大学为是目标。
explain: 以 … 为 … has no 是.

zh: 我给他钱，他反而生气了。
en: I gave him money, but he got angry instead.

prompt: Which sentence says: The weather did not get better; instead it got colder?
options: 天气不但没好，反而更冷了。
天气不但没好，更冷反而了。
zh: 天气不但没好，反而更冷了。
en: The weather did not get better; instead it got colder.
explain: 反而 comes before 更冷.

en: Hurry up, otherwise it will be late.

zh: 多穿一点衣服，不然容易感冒。
en: Wear more clothes, otherwise it is easy to catch a cold.
wrong: 多穿一点衣服，不然要是容易感冒。

en: He is still young after all.
explain: 毕竟 goes before the verb or adjective.

prompt: Which sentence says: A child is a child after all?
en: A child is a child after all.
He is only a student after all.

zh: 我想他会来，他果然来了。
en: I thought he would come, and sure enough he came.

prompt: Which sentence says: The weather forecast said rain, and sure enough it rained?
options: 天气预报说有雨，果然下雨了。
天气预报说有雨，下雨果然了。
zh: 天气预报说有雨，果然下雨了。
en: The weather forecast said rain, and sure enough it rained.
explain: 果然 comes before the verb.

en: This restaurant is indeed very tasty.
wrong: 这家饭店果然是很好吃。

en: Surprisingly, he does not know me.
He seems very tired.

prompt: Which sentence says: It seems he did not hear?
en: It seems he did not hear.
He seems not very happy.
Seen from here, the mountain is very high.

zh: 从我的经验来看，这个办法不错。
en: From my experience, this method is good.
wrong: 从我的经验来看了，这个办法不错。

en: Take him, for example: he loves sport.

prompt: Which sentence says: Take study, for example: he is better than me?
en: Take study, for example: he is better than me.
Take the north, for example: it is cold there.
wrong: 拿北边来说，那里是很冷。

en: In his view, this is easy.

prompt: Which sentence says: In my view, he is right?
en: In my view, he is right.
In short, this matter is important.

prompt: Which sentence says: Up to now, we have bought three books?
options: 到现在为止，我们已经买了三本书。
从现在为止，我们已经买了三本书。
zh: 到现在为止，我们已经买了三本书。
en: Up to now, we have bought three books.

zh: 到五点为止，我都在学校。
en: Until five o'clock, I will be at school.
wrong: 到五点为止了，我都在学校。

zh: 他凭自己的努力成功了。
en: He succeeded through his own effort.

prompt: Which sentence says: On what grounds do you say this?
en: On what grounds do you say this?
explain: 凭什么 asks on what grounds.

en: According to the rules, we must come early.

prompt: Which sentence says: According to the weather, it will rain tomorrow?
en: According to the weather, it will rain tomorrow.
explain: 依据 comes before what it rests on.

zh: 依据他的经验，这个办法可以用。
en: According to his experience, this method can be used.
wrong: 依据根据他的经验，这个办法可以用。
explain: 依据 and 根据 mean the same; use one.

zh: 我们靠自己的力量完成了工作。
en: We finished the work through our own strength.
He lives by selling fruit.

zh: 他将这件事告诉了大家。
en: He told everyone about this.
explain: 将 is a formal 把.

prompt: Which sentence says: Please close the door properly?
en: Please close the door properly.
I will take care of this.
Today's meeting is chaired by him.
wrong: 今天的会议由是他主持。

en: This is what I think.

prompt: Which sentence says: I have told you everything I know?
options: 我所知道的都告诉你了。
我知道所的都告诉你了。
zh: 我所知道的都告诉你了。
en: I have told you everything I know.
Everything he does is right.
explain: 所 + verb + 的 has no 把.

en: They do not know each other.

prompt: Which sentence says: He was so happy that he jumped up?
en: He was so happy that he jumped up.
explain: 如此 comes before the adjective.

en: Things should not be like this.
explain: 如此 already means like this.

en: You trust other people too much.

prompt: Which sentence says: He is too nervous?
en: He is too nervous.
explain: 过于 comes before the adjective.

en: This road is a little far.

prompt: Which sentence says: Please sit for a moment?
en: Please sit for a moment.
The weather is a bit cold.
He is quite busy.

prompt: Which sentence says: This matter is quite troublesome?
en: This matter is quite troublesome.
It is quite hot today.
Whatever you do, do not forget!
He really is clever!
This really is not easy.
The new term is about to start.

prompt: Which sentence says: We will move house soon?
en: We will move house soon.
explain: 将要 comes before the verb.

en: He is about to go to Shanghai.
explain: 将要 already means about to.

en: He is often late.
explain: 时常 comes before the verb.

en: He always remembers this matter.
Please call him at once.

prompt: Which sentence says: He answered at once?
en: He answered at once.
explain: 立即 comes before the verb.

en: The child is gradually growing up.

prompt: Which sentence says: The weather is gradually getting cold?
en: The weather is gradually getting cold.
explain: 逐渐 comes before the change.

en: He has not come all along.

prompt: Which sentence says: He has never agreed?
en: He has never agreed.
She has been quiet all along.
He did not eat for two days in a row.
Heavy snow went on for three days.
explain: 持续 and 连续 do not go together.

en: He returned to his home town again.

prompt: Which sentence says: We met again?
en: We met again.
explain: 再次 comes before the verb.

en: Please try once more.

zh: 他吃完饭，随后就去睡觉了。
en: He finished eating and then went to sleep.

prompt: Which sentence says: After that, he never came again?
en: After that, he never came again.
The guests left one after another.
explain: 陆续 comes before the verb.

en: He changed three jobs one after another.
wrong: 他先后一起换了三份工作。
explain: 先后 and 一起 do not go together.

en: This place is simply like a painting.
explain: 简直 adds a strong feeling.

prompt: Which sentence says: His Chinese is simply too good?
en: His Chinese is simply too good.
Today is simply too cold.
explain: Do not stack two degree words.

en: This is absolutely not true.

prompt: Which sentence says: You can absolutely relax?
en: You can absolutely relax.
explain: 绝对 comes before 可以.

en: I absolutely trust you.
I have not seen him at all.
explain: 根本 + 没 = not at all.

prompt: Which sentence says: He does not like it here at all?
en: He does not like it here at all.
This news is hard to believe.
This feeling is hard to explain.
His idea is hard to understand.
Please speak as slowly as possible.
explain: Use one of 尽量 and 尽力.

en: In case he does not come, we will leave.

prompt: Which sentence says: In case you get lost, call me?
options: 万一你迷路了，就给我打电话。
万一你迷路了，就我给打电话。
zh: 万一你迷路了，就给我打电话。
en: In case you get lost, call me.

prompt: Which sentence says: He will not come any more?
en: He will not come any more.
I have never seen him again.
No matter what I say, he does not listen to me.

prompt: Which sentence says: He thought it over and over but had no way?
en: He thought it over and over but had no way.
The children run about.
He laughed as he listened.
The child began to cry while listening.
explain: The new event comes after A着A着.

en: She fell asleep while watching.
He laughs at the drop of a hat.

prompt: Which sentence says: Go right away; do not wait any more?
en: Go right away; do not wait any more.
This place has mountains and water.

prompt: Which sentence says: They talk and laugh?
en: They talk and laugh.

prompt: Which sentence says: Staying is not right and leaving is not right?
en: Staying is not right and leaving is not right.
Neither eating nor not eating is right.
wrong: 吃也不是，不吃也都不是。
explain: No 都 inside 也不是.

en: First it is far; second it is dear.
explain: 一来 + reason, 二来 + reason.

zh: 我不去，一来太远，二来太累。
en: I am not going: first it is too far, second I am too tired.
explain: 二来 gives the second reason.

zh: 一来天气好，二来人不多。
en: First the weather is good; second there are not many people.
wrong: 一来天气好，二来是人不多。

en: Look how happy you are!

prompt: Which sentence says: Look how tired you are; have a rest now?
en: Look how tired you are; have a rest now.
Why cry? It is nothing.
Why run? It is still early.
Never mind whether it is tiring.
explain: 什么 + A + 不 + A + 的.

prompt: Which sentence says: Never mind whether it is dear; I buy it if I like it?
options: 什么贵不贵的，我喜欢就买。
什么贵的不贵，我喜欢就买。
zh: 什么贵不贵的，我喜欢就买。
en: Never mind whether it is dear; I buy it if I like it.
explain: 什么 + A + 不 + A + 的.

zh: 什么好不好的，先试一试。
en: Never mind whether it is good or not; try it first.
wrong: 什么也好不好的，先试一试。

en: The child is terribly hungry.
I am terribly busy.

prompt: Which sentence says: This dish is extremely tasty?
en: This dish is extremely tasty.
I will not manage to carry this.

prompt: Which sentence says: Will you manage to carry it by yourself?
en: Will you manage to carry it by yourself?
There is so much homework that I will not manage to do it.
wrong: 这么多作业，我做很不了。
explain: No 很 inside 做不了.

prompt: Which sentence says: This company has a very long history?
options: 这家公司有着很长的历史。
这家公司着有很长的历史。
zh: 这家公司有着很长的历史。
en: This company has a very long history.
Everyone treats him as a teacher.

zh: 我把这里看作自己的家。
en: I regard this place as my own home.
wrong: 我把这里很看作自己的家。
explain: No 很 inside 把 … 看作.

prompt: Which sentence says: The room has been swept clean?
en: The room has been swept clean.
explain: The result comes after the verb.

zh: 我们公司来了很多新人。
en: Many new people have joined our company.
A cat went missing yesterday.

prompt: Which sentence says: They played in the park yesterday?
en: They played in the park yesterday.
I study Chinese at home every day.
wrong: 我每天在家的学习汉语。

en: We go to school by car.

prompt: Which sentence says: Compared with before, he has changed a lot?
options: 跟以前相比，他变了很多。
zh: 跟以前相比，他变了很多。
en: Compared with before, he has changed a lot.
Compared with the north, the south is hotter.
wrong: 跟北方还相比，南方更热。
explain: No 还 between 跟 … and 相比.

en: He is two years younger than me.
Safety is very important.

prompt: Which sentence says: The chance of this happening is not great?
en: The chance of this happening is not great.

zh: 这个问题的重要性不小。
en: The importance of this question is not small.
wrong: 这个问题的重要性是不小。

en: The weather this month is very good.

prompt: Which sentence says: He is a local?
en: He is a local.
Our company has one hundred people.
explain: No 的 after 本公司.

en: This is one of the best methods.

prompt: Which sentence says: He is one of the tallest students in our class?
options: 他是我们班最高的学生之一。
他是之一我们班最高的学生。
zh: 他是我们班最高的学生之一。
en: He is one of the tallest students in our class.
explain: 之一 comes after the group.

en: Shanghai is one of the big cities.
I want to know whether he is coming.
explain: 是否 goes before the verb.

en: Can you speak Chinese?
